Added an AI assistant page to the portal (menu: AI assistant; also an Ask the AI assistant button on every case page). It answers questions about a selected case, eye conditions and how OcuLens works, grounded only in the case facts and a built-in eye-health knowledge base. Two engines: Claude Opus 5.5 through the Anthropic SDK (streamed, low effort, cached system prompt, server-side refusal fallback) when credentials are configured, and an offline rule-based assistant otherwise or if the API fails. Safety: never diagnoses (hedged wording), never names medicines or doses (dose sentences removed), red-flag symptoms trigger an emergency banner with standard first aid. Voice: mic input through the browser speech service (needs internet) and answers read aloud with the computer voices (offline), in English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil or Telugu; patient-friendly or clinician answer style; quick-question buttons; clear chat; transcript download. 16 new unit tests (64 in total, all passing) and a headless-browser test of the page. No API key is set on the project PC, so the portal currently runs the offline assistant.
